title: Cross-Region Surge Fire Drill: Automated Rehearsal + Hotpatch Rollback Plan
creator: Riley Chen
description: Summary: After a recent cross-region capacity blip that caused sticky-session misrouting for several hosted and Dedicated customers, we need a repeatable, automatable fire-drill (rehearsal) that exercises detection, staged traffic-shift, KV cache reconciliation, and safe hotpatch rollback. The goal is two-fold: 1) reduce mean time to safe cutover during production-region degradations, and 2) provide on-call teams with an automated toolkit and communication templates so customer escalations are handled predictably.
background: Observed a multi-customer escalation during a partial region outage where an outdated routing table + stale KV cache caused ~15% elevated 5xxs for tenants pinned to dedicated pools. The incident required manual intervention to 1) rehome traffic, 2) flush and rehydrate KV caches, and 3) apply a targeted hotpatch to a routing library. Manual steps added ~90 minutes of customer-facing degradation. This ticket packages the lessons into a rehearsable playbook plus automation to run in live and staged environments.
goals: Create an automated rehearsal harness that can be executed by on-call in <= 10 minutes
Provide a rollback-safe hotpatch procedure (PR + canary + kill-switch) for routing fixes
Document per-tenant sticky-session reconciliation steps and automate KV snapshot/replay where possible
Ship communication templates and a post-rehearsal checklist for customer success and account teams
acceptance_criteria: Rehearsal runbook executed in staging with simulated regional loss and validated traffic shift metrics
Automated KV snapshot-and-replay tool tested on a small dedicated tenant without data loss
Hotpatch procedure validated: PR -> canary (1%) -> monitor (5 min) -> promote/rollback with <3 min rollback execution time
On-call playbook published to Confluence with communication templates and notification hooks
Post-rehearsal runbook review completed and action items added to backlog
runbook_steps: 1) Detect: Use region-health alert + elevated 50th/95th p50/p95 latency and 5xx rate thresholds. Trigger rehearsal mode only with explicit on-call confirmation.
2) Quarantine: Mark impacted hosts with 'rehearsal' tagging to avoid collateral autoscale effects.
3) Canary traffic shift: Execute automated policy to reroute 1% traffic to target region model variant and monitor for errors and latency regressions for 5 minutes.
4) KV check: Run KV-consistency probe across origin and target. If divergence > 0.2%, run snapshot-and-replay with dry-run and verify checksums.
5) Hotpatch canary: Apply routing hotpatch to 1% canary pool via dedicated CI pipeline; attach kill-switch that reverses patch in <3 min.
6) Progressive ramp: If canary stable, ramp to 25% -> 50% -> 100% with automated gates tied to SLOs and customer-priority tags.
7) Finalize: Reconcile sticky sessions: issue short-lived token refresh for clients that rely on sticky routing or enable transparent session migration where supported.
8) Communications: Use prepared templates to notify affected customers and update status page; escalate to account team if tenant SLA impacted.
9) Postmortem: Capture rehearsal telemetry, annotate dashboards, and run a 72-hour regression check on model outputs for quality drift.
automation_components: rehearsal-cli: CLI to orchestrate canary routing and KV snapshot/replay
hotpatch-ci: validated pipeline with controlled rollout and automatic rollback hook
kv-audit: checksum-based probe and replay engine
notify-templates: Slack/Email/Status page templates stored in Confluence
test_plan: Unit tests for kv-audit replay logic
Staging end-to-end rehearsal against a synthetic tenant set (10 tenants) with traffic shaping
Load test of canary ramp to ensure autoscaling won't mask failures
Chaos test: confirm kill-switch cancels patch mid-ramp and system returns to pre-patch state
communication_plan: Pre-rehearsal: Notify Customer Success and small set of affected customers via prepared email template
During rehearsal: Post status updates to #incidents and status.redwood.ai; page on-call if any gate trips
Post-rehearsal: Share runbook, logs, and telemetry with customers invited to the rehearsal (recording + notes)
metrics_and_alerts: SLOs monitored: 50ms p50 token latency, 500ms p95 request latency, <0.5% 5xx rate
Gate thresholds: canary abort if >0.3% 5xx increase or p95 regression >30%
KV health signals: checksum mismatch rate, replay success rate, rehydrate latency
